decision.title: Outputs on failure are left untouched

body.p: (task 0.5). Project-wide default, chosen from the two options in docs/C_GUIDELINES.md ("Ownership and lifetimes"): a function that fails does not write its outputs. A declaration that deviates says so (the only one so far: sxml_utf8_validate fills its result on both outcomes, to report where the input stops being valid). Lifecycle functions check the configuration and memory before writing anything.
